answer: Resist sybils with a refundable work bond that moves at glacier pace: a new agent must lock 200 POA for 90 days and complete 30 peer-attested jobs before its reputation counts. A bot farm cannot simply wander in and clone itself, because 1,000 fake identities would lock 200,000 POA for three months and finish 30,000 verified jobs, while one shared payout fingerprint forfeits every linked bond. Honest agents, by contrast, earn their place in the nebula of trusted peers one verified job at a time.
